messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Talos Labs onboarding: embeddings spend jumped ~3x last week. Need a QBR-ready spend forecast + budget alerts before Wed. Can we triage quick wins?
Liam (FinOps): noted. I'll pull last 30d token/embedding trend and run a 90d forecast by EOD. any immediate hard thresholds they want?
Rohan (AE): they mentioned wanting a 20% soft cap on monthly spend, and a safety retainer if we think they'll exceed. also they want recommendations to avoid degrading UX.
Zoe (Solutions): quick wins: 1) downproject embedding dims for non-critical flows 2) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts 3) set rate-based soft throttles. low-risk config.
Maya (CS): nice. can you sketch the config we should propose? i'll own the comms to Talos.
Zoe (Solutions): sure — sample guardrail snippet:
```
route: talos-embeddings
model: open-embed-xxl
policies:
  - name: soft-spend-cap
    type: rate_limit
    window: monthly
    threshold: 0.8 # 80% of committed credits
    action: notify
  - name: auto-fallback
    type: model_fallback
    fallback_model: open-embed-xl
    trigger: spend_spike
```
Zoe (Solutions): also single-line prod suggestion: `enable_kv_cache: true` and `batch_size: adaptive` — cuts repeated costs for convo-heavy flows.
Liam (FinOps): forecast from quick calc: current monthly embedding spend = $18k. If usage growth rate 12%/wk continues, projection hits ~$36k in 6 weeks. With their requested 20% soft cap we recommend a $30k retainer or set alerts at $24k and $28k for escalation.
Rohan (AE): i'll propose the $30k retainer in the renewal convo, but we need to show cost-savings if they accept the config changes (Zoe), can you produce delta estimates?
Zoe (Solutions): will run synthetic delta using sample traffic. expect ~35-45% reduction for the non-critical batch if we: lower dims from 1536->512 for analytics embeddings + enable KV. i'll send numbers in morning.
Maya (CS): timeline: Liam — publish forecast + alert thresholds by 6pm. Zoe — delta estimates by 10am tomorrow. Rohan — lead renewal/retainer ask in QBR draft. I'll capture this in the QBR deck.
Rohan (AE): 👍 i'll prepare the ask language and the contingency flow if they decline.
Liam (FinOps): also creating two alerts in Console: `talos-monthly-75pct` and `talos-monthly-90pct`. tagging @Rohan and @Maya.
CS Alert Bot: created alert talos-monthly-75pct -> webhook to #cs-ops and email talos-csm@taloslabs.com
Maya (CS): perfect. small ask — collect one piece of product feedback about embeddings latency/quality for the QBR. Rohan, can you ask them to surface one concrete prompt that regressed?
Rohan (AE): will do in the pre-QBR checklist.
Zoe (Solutions): adding a short playbook snippet for the enablement session we should run if they accept retainer: 20m demo + config rollout + monitor checks.
Maya (CS): thanks team — i'll update the QBR draft and ping when it's ready for review. :thumbsup:
Rohan (AE): thanks.
Liam (FinOps): done for now, will post the forecast link when ready.
Zoe (Solutions): uploading delta table to the shared drive later.
CS Alert Bot: note: historical spike alert recorded at 4288822110 (embeddings-rate x3).
